findings.claim: the doctor's script-existence predicate checks a BASENAME against the fixed hooks dir while hookInvokes matches by substring, so a manifest re-pointed to ${ZCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/decoy/authoring-gate.mjs passes both probes while the dispatch ENOENTs at fire time — the predicate is a double for the runtime's path resolution and diverges exactly where production breaks
findings.proof: one-line edit re-points hooks.json args to the decoy path while the real scripts stay on disk: pluginWiringRefusal returned null (reproduced live with the doctor's exact predicate) and the doctor prints its pass line while every hook invocation ENOENTs; no pin covers the re-point shape

findings.claim: the matcher-omitted early return (pre.matcher === undefined => null) fires before the banner-event loop and the banner disk check, so a matcher-omitted manifest with banner.mjs deleted passes the judge — docs/WIRING.md's 'a registered hook script missing from disk ... all refuse' is conditional, not unconditional
findings.proof: delete the matcher key from hooks.json and rm banner.mjs (reproduced in a clone of d2674f9): the doctor prints its pass line while the banner is registered to fire at nothing; no self-test case combines matcher omission with a missing script

findings.claim: the same early return makes the new banner.mjs on-disk check unreachable on the matcher-omitted path and skips the SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit wiring law — the judge returns pass without running half its clauses on exactly the de-fanged-registration state it exists to judge
findings.proof: manifest with PreToolUse dispatching authoring-gate.mjs, no matcher, no banner events: judge returns null at the early return; blast radius bounded (the gate's disk check sits before it, the banner is advisory) hence MEDIUM

findings.claim: the script-existence pins cannot witness either disk check individually: the () => false battery case collapses at whichever check survives, and the recorded clone pin deletes only authoring-gate.mjs — the banner.mjs half of the fix is unpinned, so a one-line regression deleting either check stays green everywhere
findings.proof: mutant run with the banner check alone deleted (and with the gate check alone deleted) passes all 27 doctor cases; discriminating inputs (predicate false only for banner.mjs, or only for authoring-gate.mjs) are refused by the real judge but appear in no shipped pin
